rename.to: Bug: Animation Mesh Tearing 5.2.4-Current | aiProcess_JoinIdenticalVertices | JoinVerticesProcess.cpp

body: Thank you very much for reporting this. Can you please help me further by attaching the model used to create this bug or giving me a link for it. While I potentially have an idea on why this is happening I need to be able to reproduce it exactly to test my hypothesis.
@motazmuhammad sure here's a rigged model with animation, this alone will have holes and deform /animate improperly with join post processing  [https://we.tl/t-hWUeAEsxkk](https://we.tl/t-hWUeAEsxkk)
@kimkulling Are you aware of this issue in 5.2.4 and that it is required to go back to 5.2.3 to animate meshes, happens with pretty much any mesh.

Thank you very much for mentioning me in this. I am aware of the issue, I
am a bit busy this week. So, I will look at it at the weekend. Please be
patient with me.
